notices.title: A new version of Lunchbox is available
notices.body: You're on 0.1.1, which can't update itself on a Mac. Paste one line in Terminal and Lunchbox updates and reopens with everything as it was. After that, updates take one click.

notices.title: Lunchbox 0.1.8 is here
notices.body: Google's agent works again, through Antigravity. Pick model and effort side by side for every agent, type / for every agent's commands, and ask the new Workshop for anything Lunchbox is missing. Agents now work until they are done. One click updates, and your rooms open where you left them.

notices.title: Lunchbox 0.1.8 is here
notices.body: Google's agent works again, through Antigravity, with model and effort side by side and the new Workshop. It downloads by itself: click Restart now at the top of the window, or quit and reopen Lunchbox. Your rooms open where you left them.
